## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `sap-s4hana-api-sales-inquiry-srv-setup-g`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Verify or activate the API_SALES_INQUIRY_SRV OData service

1. <!-- manual: Log on to the SAP S/4HANA back-end system (via SAP GUI or SAP Fiori Launchpad as an administrator). -->
2. <!-- manual: Run transaction SOAMANAGER (for older systems) or navigate to API Management in the Fiori Launchpad. -->
3. <!-- manual: Search for the service API_SALES_INQUIRY_SRV. -->
4. <!-- manual: If the service is not yet active, select it and choose Activate. -->
5. Confirm the service endpoint path: `/sap/opu/odata/sap/API_SALES_INQUIRY_SRV`.

## Step 3: Assign OData authorizations to the SAP user

1. <!-- manual: Open transaction SU01 (User Maintenance) and navigate to the target user. -->
2. <!-- manual: On the Roles or Profiles tab, assign one of the following depending on your landscape: -->
3. <!-- manual: SAP standard role SAP_SD_BC_SALES_INQUIRY_READ (read access to sales inquiry API), or -->
4. A custom role containing authorization object `S_SERVICE` with the field `SRV_NAME` = `API_SALES_INQUIRY_SRV`.
5. <!-- manual: Save the user record. -->

## Step 4: Collect credentials for the integration user

1. Confirm the SAP username (e.g., `BALI_INT_USR`) and its password with your SAP administrator.
2. Verify the user is not locked and does not have an expired password by checking **SU01**.
3. <!-- manual: Optionally, test the credentials against the OData service using a REST client: -->
